findings.highlight: I went to bed, closed my eyes, and said good night
findings.evidenceJa: フトンをかぶって、目をとじて、ちゃんとおやすみなさいって言った
findings.governingReading: the child pulled the futon over himself, closed his eyes, and properly said goodnight
findings.explanation: The childlike sequence loses the concrete blanket action and the emphasis that he followed bedtime correctly.

findings.highlight: in the next instant, my world turned red
findings.evidenceJa: つぎにやってきたのはマッカなけしきだけだった
findings.governingReading: the next thing that came was nothing but a scarlet scene
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents instantaneous transformation and changes an arriving field of vision into the child’s whole world turning red.

findings.highlight: the burning hallway
findings.evidenceJa: ごうごうともえるロウカ
findings.governingReading: the hallway burning with a roar
findings.explanation: The English omits the overwhelming fire sound from the child’s memory.

findings.highlight: I heard my mom’s voice behind us
findings.evidenceJa: うしろからお母さんのこえがした
findings.governingReading: his mother’s voice came from behind
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that both father and child share the deictic “us.”

findings.highlight: I should be fine by myself
findings.evidenceJa: ひとりでいけるな
findings.governingReading: you can go on alone, right
findings.explanation: The father’s instruction about the child moving alone becomes a general reassurance about independence.

findings.highlight: told me to wait here
findings.evidenceJa: 外でまっていなさい
findings.governingReading: told him to wait outside
findings.explanation: The English removes the destination that sends the child out of the burning house.

findings.highlight: It wasn’t much different outside
findings.evidenceJa: 外もうちのなかと変わらなかった
findings.governingReading: outside was no different from inside the house
findings.explanation: An exact equivalence in the child’s engulfing fire experience is weakened.

findings.highlight: I probably got punished
findings.evidenceJa: バチがあたってしまったんだ
findings.governingReading: he was punished because he disobeyed
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds adult uncertainty to the child’s absolute self-blaming conclusion.

findings.highlight: I raised my head which I’d kept hidden with my hands
findings.evidenceJa: 手でかくしていた顔をあげる
findings.governingReading: he raises the face he had covered with his hands
findings.explanation: The English makes the head itself hidden and produces awkward physical staging.

findings.highlight: I finally confronted the scene
findings.evidenceJa: 初めて、その光景と正面から対峙した
findings.governingReading: for the first time, he confronted that scene head-on
findings.explanation: “Finally” replaces the first occurrence and the direct face-to-face quality disappears.

findings.highlight: an event that cannot be redone
findings.evidenceJa: 変えられない出来事だ
findings.governingReading: an event that cannot be changed
findings.explanation: The English shifts irreversible reality into inability to repeat or redo the event.

findings.highlight: the presence of death wanting to take me
findings.evidenceJa: 生きている俺を仲間にしたがる死の気配
findings.governingReading: the presence of death wanting to make the living child one of its companions
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes the child’s image of death recruiting him into the dead.

findings.highlight: The air I breathed in stung my burned esophagus
findings.evidenceJa: 吸う息が焼けた食道を突き刺していく
findings.governingReading: each inhaled breath pierces his burned esophagus
findings.explanation: Piercing internal pain is weakened to stinging air.

findings.highlight: My eyes abandoned their function
findings.evidenceJa: 眼球は正常な役割を放棄して
findings.governingReading: his eyeballs abandon their normal role
findings.explanation: The anatomical object and loss of normal operation become generic eyes abandoning an unspecified function.

findings.highlight: my brain was being steamed inside my skull. steamed.
findings.evidenceJa: 脳みそは頭の中で蒸し焼きだ
findings.governingReading: his brain is being steam-roasted inside his head
findings.explanation: A stray repeated “steamed” corrupts the sentence, and steam-roasting is weakened to steaming.

findings.highlight: It passed the boiling point to reach the freezing point
findings.evidenceJa: 沸点を超えたらぐるりと回って凍結温度
findings.governingReading: past boiling, temperature circles all the way around to freezing
findings.explanation: The surreal full-circle inversion is reduced to linear passage between temperatures.

findings.highlight: The burning blood froze up
findings.evidenceJa: 燃える血はすぐに固まって止まってしまい
findings.governingReading: the burning blood immediately solidifies and stops
findings.explanation: The English omits immediacy and the blood ceasing movement.

findings.highlight: it was ridiculously hot
findings.evidenceJa: おかしくなるほど熱かった
findings.governingReading: it was hot enough to drive him mad or make him strange
findings.explanation: The mental-breaking degree of heat becomes casual comic emphasis.

findings.highlight: I got scared and ran away
findings.evidenceJa: コわくなって逃げダした
findings.governingReading: the frightened child’s words visibly fracture between scripts as he runs
findings.explanation: mirror moon regularizes the marked katakana intrusions that make the remembered child voice break down.

findings.highlight: burning up and dying seemed like a human death
findings.evidenceJa: やけしぬのはニンゲンらしくてただしいとおもった
findings.governingReading: he thought burning to death was humanlike and therefore right or proper
findings.explanation: The English preserves human death but omits the child’s horrifying judgment that it is the correct alternative.

findings.highlight: I found out that it was going to rain soon
findings.evidenceJa: いずれ雨が降ると知って
findings.governingReading: knowing that rain would fall eventually
findings.explanation: Existing knowledge and indefinite futurity become a new discovery that rain is imminent.

findings.highlight: I look around my room, my mind still asleep
findings.evidenceJa: 目覚めたばかりの頭で、ぼんやりと自分の部屋を見渡した
findings.governingReading: with a just-awakened mind, he hazily looks around his room
findings.explanation: The English turns residual grogginess into the mind literally remaining asleep and drops the hazy perception.

findings.highlight: I sigh with relief in my futon
findings.evidenceJa: 横になったまま、ほう、と胸を撫で下ろす
findings.governingReading: still lying down, he exhales and strokes his chest in relief
findings.explanation: The physical gesture and continued prone position disappear.

findings.highlight: after seeing a nightmare
findings.evidenceJa: 夢から覚めて
findings.governingReading: after waking from a dream
findings.explanation: mirror moon classifies the experience as a nightmare where Shirou uses the neutral “dream.”

findings.highlight: My temples feel hot
findings.evidenceJa: 額に熱さを感じながら
findings.governingReading: feeling heat in his forehead
findings.explanation: The location of Shirou’s fever sensation shifts to both temples.

findings.highlight: I used to have this nightmare all the time
findings.evidenceJa: この夢を見て何度もうなされた
findings.governingReading: he saw this dream and was repeatedly tormented by it
findings.explanation: Frequency of having the dream replaces the distinct consequence of waking or suffering from it.

findings.highlight: I thought I would never be able to forget about that day
findings.evidenceJa: 忘れる日が来るなんて、それこそ夢にも思えなかった
findings.governingReading: he never dreamed a day would come when he forgot
findings.explanation: A future change that seemed unimaginable becomes a claim about his ability to forget one particular day.

findings.highlight: Everything was real again once I fell asleep
findings.evidenceJa: 現実となって在り続けた
findings.governingReading: it became reality and continued to exist whenever he fell asleep
findings.explanation: The English omits the nightmare world’s persistence.

findings.highlight: all I saw when I had that dream was a field of red
findings.evidenceJa: 繰り返すのは一面の赤色だけだった
findings.governingReading: the only thing the dream repeated was a field of red
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the diminished dream’s repetitive content into the limit of Shirou’s vision.

findings.highlight: Why did my dream contain as far as the smell of the burning air
findings.evidenceJa: 爆ぜる空気の匂いまで実感するような夢
findings.governingReading: a dream vivid enough to feel even the smell of bursting, burning air
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically malformed and weakens the exploding air to merely burning air.

findings.highlight: I don’t remember such a thing, nor do I recognize it
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は知らないし覚えていない
findings.governingReading: he neither knows nor remembers such a thing
findings.explanation: Knowledge becomes visual recognition and the two epistemic limits are reordered.

findings.highlight: The breaker in my body trips, telling me not to think about it
findings.evidenceJa: 体についたブレイカーが落ちかける
findings.governingReading: the breaker attached to his body threatens to trip
findings.explanation: A near-triggered bodily metaphor becomes a completed event and is given an explicit verbal message.

findings.highlight: My pajamas are damp with my sweat
findings.evidenceJa: 寝巻きは汗を吸って気持ち悪い
findings.governingReading: his sleepwear has absorbed the sweat and feels unpleasant
findings.explanation: The English retains moisture but loses absorption and bodily discomfort.

findings.highlight: My arm feels heavy
findings.evidenceJa: 腕がだるい
findings.governingReading: his arm feels sluggish or languid
findings.explanation: mirror moon substitutes weight for feverish weakness.

findings.highlight: When I place my hand on my forehead, I realize that it’s hot
findings.evidenceJa: ゆるゆると手を額にあてると、それなりに熱かった
findings.governingReading: when he slowly places a hand on his forehead, it is reasonably or appreciably hot
findings.explanation: The English removes his weak motion and overstates a qualified temperature judgment as an epiphany.

findings.highlight: I’ve had bruises pretty often
findings.evidenceJa: 生傷は絶えなかった
findings.governingReading: fresh injuries had never ceased
findings.explanation: Ongoing cuts and wounds become occasional bruising.

findings.highlight: That must be why I had such a dream
findings.evidenceJa: だからあんな夢を見たのかな
findings.governingReading: perhaps that is why he had such a dream
findings.explanation: A question-like hypothesis becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: what am I just lying around for
findings.evidenceJa: 何くつろいでんだよ俺は
findings.governingReading: why am I relaxing
findings.explanation: The joke targets Shirou’s complacency; the English changes it to physical inactivity.

findings.highlight: Why!? How can this be
findings.evidenceJa: なんで、どうして、どのように
findings.governingReading: why, for what reason, and in what manner
findings.explanation: mirror moon collapses the deliberately frantic three-part question into two.

findings.highlight: This isn’t the time to worry about little things like being sick
findings.evidenceJa: 体がだるいとか腕に力が入らないとか言ってる場合じゃない
findings.governingReading: this is no time to talk about his sluggish body or lack of strength in his arms
findings.explanation: Specific alarming symptoms become “little things” and a generic illness.

findings.highlight: I have to check something far more important
findings.evidenceJa: 布団の中を確認する
findings.governingReading: he checks inside the futon
findings.explanation: The explicit-content branch adds an evaluative sentence absent from the active Japanese source.

findings.highlight: There’s no one in my futon with me
findings.evidenceJa: 体中寝汗でびっしょりだっただけ
findings.governingReading: his whole body is merely soaked in night sweat
findings.explanation: The explicit-content branch inserts a check for another person in Shirou’s futon, which the active Japanese does not state.

findings.highlight: nor would Tohsaka ever want to… um… do it with me
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂とおかしなコトになったワケでもない
findings.governingReading: nothing strange happened between him and Tohsaka
findings.explanation: The explicit-content branch invents a proposition about Rin’s willingness to have sex with Shirou rather than simply denying the dream event.

findings.highlight: I fall back to the futon
findings.evidenceJa: ばふり、と派手に背中から倒れこんだ
findings.governingReading: he falls spectacularly backward onto his back with a muffled baf sound
findings.explanation: The English removes sound, force, and body orientation from the comic collapse.

findings.highlight: I hear Saber’s voice from the other side of the door
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ふすま]襖ごしにセイバーの声がする
findings.governingReading: Saber’s voice comes through the fusuma partition
findings.explanation: The English again changes the house’s sliding partition into a door.

findings.highlight: I’ll never be able to look Tohsaka in the eye again
findings.evidenceJa: どの[ruby text=ツラ]面さげて遠坂に会えというのだ
findings.governingReading: with what face could he possibly meet Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shirou’s shame about presenting himself before Rin becomes inability to make eye contact.

findings.highlight: Saber comes in
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが入ってくる
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates a semicolon-commented statement that Saber enters the room.

findings.highlight: I try to act calm
findings.evidenceJa: 平静を装って声をかける
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates semicolon-commented narration describing Shirou feigning calm.

findings.highlight: after looking at the medical thermometer
findings.evidenceJa: 体温計を片手に
findings.governingReading: with the thermometer in one hand
findings.explanation: A concrete pose becomes a prior act of looking at the instrument.

findings.highlight: She’s good at treating wounds
findings.evidenceJa: 切り傷の手当てならお手の物
findings.governingReading: treating cuts is second nature to Taiga
findings.explanation: The specific household familiarity with cuts becomes medical competence with wounds generally.

findings.highlight: not used to treating sick people
findings.evidenceJa: こういう病気の手当てには慣れていない
findings.governingReading: not accustomed to caring for this kind of illness
findings.explanation: The type of ailment becomes a type of patient.

findings.highlight: Which do you think is more important, food or Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎と朝ご飯、どっちが大切
findings.governingReading: which matters more, Shirou or breakfast
findings.explanation: The concrete daily meal whose preparation Shirou prioritizes becomes food in general.

findings.highlight: Saber-chan came and got me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーちゃんが呼んでくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber called Taiga
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds Saber physically fetching Taiga.

findings.highlight: she’s feeling better
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体調はもういいんだ
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s condition is already all right
findings.explanation: Full apparent recovery becomes relative improvement.

findings.highlight: I’ve recovered
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと熱は引きました
findings.governingReading: her fever has properly gone down
findings.explanation: A specific symptom resolution becomes recovery from the whole illness.

findings.highlight: It’s all thanks to your treatment
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が看てくれたおかげ
findings.governingReading: thanks to Senpai watching over and caring for her
findings.explanation: Sakura’s gratitude for Shirou staying with her becomes gratitude for medical treatment.

findings.highlight: Stop making that face
findings.evidenceJa: すごく邪な感じがするんでやめてくれ
findings.governingReading: stop because that expression feels extremely improper or lewd
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s reason for objecting and the sexual coloring that launches Taiga’s joke.

findings.highlight: I just gave her some medicine yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日は熱計って薬出しただけ
findings.governingReading: yesterday he only took her temperature and gave her medicine
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the temperature check from Shirou’s flustered defense.

findings.highlight: you’re not man enough for that
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎にはそんな甲斐性ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou lacks that kind of capability or romantic resourcefulness
findings.explanation: The teasingly broad 甲斐性 is narrowed into a challenge to masculinity.

findings.highlight: That’s offending as well
findings.evidenceJa: それはそれでムカツク
findings.governingReading: that irritates him in its own way
findings.explanation: The English uses the malformed expression “that’s offending.”

findings.highlight: look over him so that he does not escape
findings.evidenceJa: シロウが起きださぬよう監視
findings.governingReading: watch Shirou so that he does not get up
findings.explanation: Saber’s prisonlike joke is sharpened from preventing him rising from bed to preventing escape.

findings.highlight: did I feel a chill run up my spine
findings.evidenceJa: 得も言えぬ危機感が走った
findings.governingReading: an indescribable sense of danger ran through him
findings.explanation: The English replaces an intuitive threat assessment with a stock bodily fear response.

findings.highlight: you’re going to rest today and cure that cold of yours
findings.evidenceJa: それまでに体を治しておくこと
findings.governingReading: have his body recovered by then, before dinner
findings.explanation: Taiga’s deliberately impossible deadline becomes a general instruction for the day.

findings.highlight: smiles at me while making unreasonable demands
findings.evidenceJa: うんうん、と笑顔で無理難題を言いつける
findings.governingReading: Taiga nods cheerfully while imposing the impossible demand
findings.explanation: The English omits the self-satisfied nodding that carries the comic delivery.

findings.highlight: Sakura behind her, looking like she wants to say something
findings.evidenceJa: 何か言いたそうに俯いている桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura behind Taiga, looking down as though she wants to say something
findings.explanation: Sakura’s downcast posture, central to her hesitancy, disappears.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee waves goodbye and leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえは出勤していった
findings.governingReading: Taiga waves and leaves for work
findings.explanation: The English omits that Taiga departs for her job at school.

findings.highlight: I only walked out to the porch, but by the time I get back, I’m so tired that I practically collapse into bed
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋から縁側に出ただけだっていうのに、手足は休息を欲しがってすぐに倒れてしまう
findings.governingReading: although he only stepped from the room onto the veranda, his limbs demand rest and he immediately collapses
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a return journey and bed destination while removing the limbs’ immediate physical failure.

findings.highlight: I don’t have a bad cold
findings.evidenceJa: 熱はそう高くない
findings.governingReading: his fever is not especially high
findings.explanation: A measured symptom becomes a diagnosis of overall illness severity.

findings.highlight: I should sleep and get my energy back
findings.evidenceJa: しばらく横になって体力を戻さないと
findings.governingReading: he must lie down for a while and recover his strength
findings.explanation: Resting prone becomes sleeping.

findings.highlight: she’s not going to school, right
findings.evidenceJa: 学校を休むって事だよな
findings.governingReading: that means deliberately taking the day off school
findings.explanation: The English removes the active decision to be absent that sets up Sakura’s “cheating” language.

findings.highlight: Are you still a bit sick
findings.evidenceJa: 桜もまだ熱があるのか
findings.governingReading: does Sakura still have a fever
findings.explanation: Shirou asks about a specific continuing fever; the English generalizes it to mild illness.

findings.highlight: it seems impossible that she could recover in only one night
findings.evidenceJa: 一晩ですっかり良くなるってのも無茶な話
findings.governingReading: complete recovery in one night is an unreasonable proposition
findings.explanation: mirror moon strengthens Shirou’s practical doubt into impossibility.

findings.highlight: you were sick after all
findings.evidenceJa: 風邪気味だった
findings.governingReading: she had been showing signs of a cold
findings.explanation: A qualified cold-like condition becomes confirmed sickness.

findings.highlight: Don’t you have to call the school and let them know
findings.evidenceJa: 欠席届とか出さないで
findings.governingReading: without submitting an absence notice or the like
findings.explanation: A formal school notice becomes a telephone call.

findings.highlight: I’m thinking of skipping
findings.evidenceJa: ずる、しちゃおうかなって
findings.governingReading: she is thinking of “cheating,” deliberately playing truant
findings.explanation: The English loses Sakura’s guilty moral framing of the absence.

findings.highlight: Sakura hangs her head even more
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はますます俯いてしまう
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates a semicolon-commented gesture that intensifies Sakura’s downcast posture.

findings.highlight: I take walks during the night
findings.evidenceJa: 最近は夜になると散歩してて
findings.governingReading: lately Shirou has been going for walks at night
findings.explanation: The English drops the recent onset that covertly refers to his Grail War patrols.

findings.highlight: so that must’ve been it
findings.evidenceJa: それで勝手に風邪引いた
findings.governingReading: he caught the cold on his own as a result
findings.explanation: mirror moon promotes Shirou’s cover story into certain causation and omits his insistence that Sakura bears no responsibility.

findings.highlight: She’s so tense that she might shatter if I poke her
findings.evidenceJa: 指で突つくとカッチーンって響きそうなぐらい体をカチカチにして
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration: Sakura stiffens so completely that a poke seems likely to ring with a metallic kachiin
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates semicolon-commented comic narration and changes ringing rigidity into physical shattering.

findings.highlight: it’s relieving to have Sakura here
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が傍にいてくれるなら安心できる
findings.governingReading: Shirou can feel secure if Sakura stays beside him
findings.explanation: The English weakens the relational sense of safety into momentary relief.

findings.highlight: It’ll be a huge help
findings.evidenceJa: 情けないんだが
findings.governingReading: shameful though it is for Shirou to ask
findings.explanation: The English omits Shirou’s embarrassment about depending on Sakura.

findings.highlight: if you can cook lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 昼飯とか作ってくれると助かる
findings.governingReading: it would help if Sakura handled lunch and similar needs
findings.explanation: The broader request for daytime care is narrowed to cooking lunch.
